text:
mel: Quick report  — found anchors breaking when a heading follows a Markdown table. Link to failing fragment: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/ops/#rollback-steps doesn't jump.

zack: Example snippet from ops/incident-handling.md:
```markdown
| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1    | check logs |
### Rollback steps
1. stop scale
2. revert image
```

anya: I can repro with mkdocs build — heading id becomes `rollback-steps-1`. Looks like tables produce an implicit id collision or the slugger treats table as preceding content with empty id.

zack: CI linkcheck output:
```
[linkcheck] ERROR: Fragment not found: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/#rollback-steps
[docusaurus] ERROR: anchor not found for #rollback-steps
```

mel: Short-term: insert explicit anchor before heading or give heading an explicit slug if parser supports `{#rollback-steps}`. I'll push anchor to branch fix/table-heading-anchor.

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-1420--staging.docs.redwood.ai/ops/incident-handling (build 1420) :white_check_mark:

anya: Pushed PR with anchor and updated 3 failing links. Also added a migration note docs/migration/TABLE-HEADING-ANCHORS.md advising anchors for headings after tables/figures.

zack: Can we run a repo scan: `git grep -n "^|" docs/ | xargs -I{} sed -n '1,6p' {} | grep -n '###'`  rough idea to find table->heading patterns.

mel: Filed follow-up DOCS-789 to fix slugify plugin and add CI regression to detect table->heading fragment mismatches.

docs-bot: PR opened: redwood/docs#3501 






   — fix: explicit anchors for headings after tables (assignees: mel, anya) 
 reviewers: zack.

mel: Thanks all — after merge let's run full linkcheck and report remaining failures here.
